detail: Estate chronology and identities including Old Hall, Chapel, Gatehouse, Stone Buildings and Great Hall.
Owner gives October 1845 opening date and 125 by 45 foot interior.
Great Hall designed by Hardwick with red brick and blue diaper, tall windows and stone dressings.
Library adjoining Great Hall, red brick and stone dressings.
Chapel sits over vaulted open undercroft with four bays, Perpendicular windows, green slate and pinnacles.
Old Hall dates 1489–92 with later rebuilt sections, red brick, blue diaper work, gables and stone windows.
Chancery Lane Tudor gatehouse with four-story arch, taller north tower, lead roof, west diapers and three armorial panels.
Numbers 8–11 Stone Buildings, three storeys, sash windows, rusticated ashlar, fanlights and historical railings.
